name: ATEK303
author: Animatek
tagline: The ATEK303 acid voice and a TR drum track on the M-VAVE FM-1
description: ATEK303 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an acid groovebox: the ATEK303 engine (Open303) and its acid pattern generator, plus a drum track: eight analogue TR-808/909/707 voices (kick, snare, clap, hats, toms, cowbell/rim) with their own 64-step sequencer on the same clock. Press PLAY and a line and a beat play; generate, mutate and undo both patterns (LOCK mutates), edit the 303 in a piano roll and the drums in an 8x16 matrix, swing the drums, switch kits, add drive, chorus, delay and reverb. 14 WAVE oscillators, LEVEL/TUNE/DECAY per part, 8 factory presets in 32 slots (DR64), MIDI in and out.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Hügelton Instruments). The voice is ATEK303 by Animatek, on Open303 by Robin Schmidt.
